paragraphs: Chapter 546
Episode 145. Prologue (15)
The Overlord Sword, the sealed weapon of the Hyran Imperial Sword.
Conceived about five hundred years ago and developed by the Hyran House and the Sword Saints, the Overlord Sword has never been revealed to the world.
When Ron mentioned its name, the Sword Saints' eyes changed. Suddenly, the aura pouring from their bodies engraved strange patterns all over them, like runes.
Murky whirlpools spun in their pupils, and their pure white coats, symbolizing the Sword Saints, were stained ash-gray.
The transformation seemed to be caused not by aura but by an ancient dark magic or some other forbidden spell.
'The Overlord Sword... is this the sword of Hyran?' Jin thought.

The Imperial Sword symbolizes the 'righteous path.' The swords wielded by the successors of the Imperial Sword usually exuded a unique aura, pure yet powerful, but the current transformation of the Sword Saints showed completely opposite attributes.
It was murky, dark, and ominous.
It seemed more like a form of a curse rather than martial arts.
Anyone who witnessed the aura of the Overlord Sword would instinctively realize this - once you wield this sword, you can never return to your former self.
Also, the aura of the Overlord Sword strangely resembled a sword technique Jin was familiar with. The Path of Defeat, the sword of Runcandel.
"The 24th head of our house created this sword not for the battle with Zifel, but to prepare for a possible showdown with Runcandel," Ron said.

That was why the Overlord Sword, created five hundred years ago, had never been revealed to the world. It was a seal device, created following their sword technique, solely in preparation for Runcandel's invasion.
The purpose of the Overlord Sword does not include Hyran's righteousness.
It was an extreme sword, created to stand against the ultimate power, even if it meant discarding the body in an instant.
In some ways, the Overlord Sword emitted an even more brutal and savage scent than Runcandel's sword, which had the safety device of a 'blessed body.'
It was as if you could hear the eerie breath of beasts that had forsaken their future to win a fight.
"It's strange... to bring out such an Overlord Sword, together with Runcandel, to fight against Zifel," Ron murmured.
Snap!
The Sword Saints drew their swords and lowered their postures. The stones of the wall they stood on burst, leaving deep footprints.
"Sword Saint Leader Luyan, Overlord Sword activation complete. We will obey the Lord's command."
"Sword Saint Aqita Hyran, Overlord Sword activation complete. We will obey the Lord's command."
"Sword Saint Erol Raimon, Overlord Sword activation complete. We will obey the Lord's command."
"Sword Saint Bel Altemiro, Overlord Sword activation complete. We will obey the Lord's command."
"Sword Saint Frantz, Overlord Sword activation complete. We will obey the Lord's command."
The Swordmasters all drew their swords simultaneously.

At the same time, sword energy poured out from their blades towards the fleet. The gloomy ash-colored sword energy, shining, pierced through Kelliac's flame barrier in an instant and showed a sight of moving towards the inner fleet.
It left a monstrous trail as if some gigantic being had scratched it. Ron's formless sword energy was assisting the Swordmasters' attack, ripping the flame barrier apart in a flash.
Ashy smells came from the falling pieces of flame. The thick smoke that spread as the sword energy swallowed the fire completely obstructed the view.
The five dark shining swords did not hesitate and continued their attack again.

No matter where in the sky they swung towards the front, it was full of enemies, and any slightly deviated sword energy joined with Ron's formless sword energy and found its place, so the pitch-dark view was not a problem at all.
The formless and ash-colored, the two types of sword energy were relentlessly hitting the fleet. Every now and then, screams of humans and dragons, whose owners were unknown, could be heard.
It was already beyond expectation with Ron's increased power, and now the change of the Swordmasters was added.
'Their resistance is fierce.'
However, Kelliac was no longer flustered.
When he first confirmed Ron's non-violence and gritted his teeth, it wasn't because he might lose this war.
Such anxiety didn't exist even a speck.
The reason Kelliac was momentarily engulfed in a sense of defeat was because he was overtaken by Ron in the competition of the category called 'human'.
He once again felt the deep inferiority he had always felt from Sirron since his youth.
'I admit it, my friends. As a human, I couldn't beat you.'
However, the magic stone could lead him to something beyond human. A god, or even more transcendental...
The Huroti glowed red.
Annihilation Dark Sky Flame Jade, Demon Emperor 2 Type.
A sphere of fire that swallows smoke and spins was visible.
That sphere, even larger than what Jin formed by borrowing the will of Soldieret and Clam in the first battle, had the dignity of the peak of magic unfolded directly.
In his previous life, Jin had only once seen the Annihilation Dark Sky Flame Jade Type 2, unfolded by Valeria.
"This is His Majesty's..."
Rata looked up at the sphere of fire and said.
Most of the Barmul Union and the Sword Emperor City mistook that Kelliac was using the same magic as Jin. They thought that the power increased because a stronger wizard used the same magic.
And everyone had no choice but to be nervous because they knew what kind of power the legacy of Liole that Jin unfolded showed.
"Kelliac Ziphil, you weren't just playing around either. Luyan!"
"Yes, Lord."
"I'll block that. Octavia will certainly aim to infiltrate in that gap...."
While Ron was speaking, Jin was recalling the story Valeria from his previous life had told him.
-"The Amethyst Flame Sphere, Demon King Version 2, has superior firepower than the final version according to records.
-"I guess the final version is superior in other aspects. Stability?"
-"Yes, stability. The final version is a refined version of the 2nd version which can be used stably. But that's not all.
-"What other differences are there?"

-"Weaknesses. The 2nd version is the strongest, but its weaknesses are too obvious. There's a flaw that doesn't exist in the first version. Normally, one wouldn't survive seeing this magic, and there are hardly any remarkable individuals who could dare to analyze Riol's perfect magic, so it's an area that's unknown but... Look here."
At that time, Valeria had demonstrated the 2nd version herself near Hyster's heritage site and explained it. Behind her, just as now, was an enormous flame sphere.

-"It's like a paper that reveals writing when wet. Just like that. When the 2nd version starts, if you spread out the magic power like this around the 2nd version... Try it yourself, I can't cast another spell while maintaining this."
At that time, as soon as he scattered the magic power according to her words, Jin immediately understood the weakness of the 2nd version.
He began to see the flow of magic power constituting the Amethyst Flame Sphere, Demon King Version 2.
The invisible runes sparkled and many lines appeared between the runes.
-"Cutting those lines can be said to be the cancellation formula for the 2nd version. And you know what happens when the spell is cut off by someone other than the caster, right?
-"Magic backflow....."
-"Yes, if you cut those lines now, I'll likely die. I can't handle the backflow of magic power of this magnitude."
Therefore, the natural enemy of the 2nd version was a mage knight, or a combination of a magician and a knight who knew the weaknesses of the 2nd version.
The magician would reveal the runes and lines with magic, and the knight would have the role of cutting them.
The final version, unlike the 2nd version, did not have runes revealed as weaknesses, which is why it was the ultimate Amethyst Flame Sphere.
-"Sir Ron, I will stop that with the Bamul Alliance and the Sword Saints."
Ron's pupils widened. Jin was stepping forward to stop the magic that even he would have to prepare to use Aura and True Qi to stop.
But Ron didn't demand confirmation from Jin. He didn't scold him for showing reckless courage, questioning how he would manage to do something that even Ron couldn't easily accomplish.
He simply believed in Jin. To Ron, Jin was no longer a child or a martial artist below him, but a martial artist who always succeeded in whatever he claimed.
-"What can I do to help?"
-"If possible, please allow the knights to fly through the sky using your sword wind."
The martial artists of the 10th rank often used their sword Qi as a means of flight when fighting in the air.
Ron had reached a level where he could not only do that, but also allow others to fly.
"How long?"
"5 minutes, no, 3 minutes should be enough. If you can perfectly protect our allies in the air."
Ron smiled subtly.
That's because he wouldn't have to expend True Qi for such a short time.
"Sounds easy enough. Shall we start immediately?"
"Yes."
Whoosh!
Suddenly, a strong formless wind enveloped the bodies of the Bamul Alliance and the Sword Saints. The knights, swept up by the wind, began to rise into the dawn sky.
"Follow Jin Runecandel's command until the end of Kelliac's magic, Sword Saints."
Jin was opening his magic power. His immense magical power intertwined with the magic of nature, and a dense white mirage bloomed.
And into that, the flames of the Amethyst Flame Sphere, Demon King Version 2, began to fall. Swirling bands of flame fiercely covered the knights rising to the sky.

Ron let out a battle cry and radiated an intangible sword Qi. Sword Qi and flames collided, causing a deafening explosion, and the knights heightened their senses, confirming that all these explosions were happening right in front of them.
A precarious standoff was taking place between the sword and the fire.
Jin did not quickly scatter the already opened magic power, just in case Kelliac became aware of the 2nd version's weakness.
'At this point, I can scatter it all at once.'
Thus, about a minute had passed.
"Bamul Alliance, Sword Saints! Destroy the runes and sever the lines of magic power connected between them!"
The moment Jin shouted that, the one most surprised was certainly Kelliac Zefil.
'He's figured out the cancellation formula of the 2nd version...?'
No, that couldn't be.
This was a response that could only be made by someone who already knew. And as far as Kelliac knew, apart from him, there was only one person in the world who knew the weaknesses of the 2nd version.
Valeria Hyster, the last survivor of the Hyster Family.
Kelliac could finally confirm that she already had a relationship with Jin. But it was already too late.
Even if he were Riol Zefil, he couldn't retract the already deployed 2nd version in an instant.

The Bamul Alliance and the Sword Saints were already slashing towards the runes and lines of the 2nd version. And Jin, marking the positions of the runes and lines too far for their swords to reach, prepared the secret technique of the Runecandel.
Runecandel Secret Technique No.5
Light Speed Piercing - Nameless King
Far beyond the flames, the electric sword Qi of a raging thunderstorm was stretching towards the shining runes.
